caption_fb:
The Kashubian capital of America is in Minnesota.

Kashubians, from the Baltic coast of northern Poland, began leaving for America in 1855. So many settled in Winona, Minnesota, that it's known as "the Kashubian capital of America."

Kashubian records and surnames can look different from the rest of Poland, so knowing your family's region can change where you search.

Poland today has 16 regions. Going Back to Poland has a page for each, so you can place your family's village on the map.

Any Kashubian roots here? 👇
